en:
In Eiroku 3, Imagawa Yoshimoto
of Suruga, set on ruling the realm,
began his march on the capital.
Leading a vast army of 25,000 to
Kyoto, he seemed to have no rival.

But Yoshimoto's dream fell
at Okehazama.

Oda Nobunaga, a minor lord
of Owari. With a mere 2,000 men,
he crushed Imagawa's 25,000.
This man would go on to change
the course of this age of war.

note: Label limit 96 px. Pattern 'Visit Okimoto's Res.' (U00136) gives 'Visit Takamoto's Res.' (105 px), so 'Visit' became 'To' (95 px). Takamoto is away at Moji Castle; the residence is where his wife and Terumoto live. 0.2.14: written in full, since the scene-goal box now fits the English text (the shortened form was for the 8 px per character box).

en:
Your mother hasn't forgotten you
for even a single day......

You've always been stubborn, so
I wonder if you can't bring yourself
to come home and are at a loss?
note: As U03336, re-broken to the 3 lines of this version. Shared by 5 occurrences.

en:
Even if your work isn't going
well, your mother doesn't mind
in the least.
Above all, what matters most
is that you stay well.

Just come home to me safe and well,
and that will be enough......
I'm always waiting eagerly
for your return.
